tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Night is the default: the brand lives after dark. Paper is a near-white for daylight play outdoors, print and long reading.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and sheets that sit on ground (case brief, team roster).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, menus, anything one step above surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet borders. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (ghost button, input). Meets 3:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the wordmark, on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, mono labels. 4.5:1+ on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: THE red thread: a vivid signal red, the one accent. The thread line, the primary button fill, pins on ground. 4.5:1 on Paper ground, 4.1:1 on Night ground (graphics and text 24px+ there). Small red text uses thread-text; on manila use manila-thread (thread is 2.9:1 there).

tokens.name: thread-text
tokens.usage: Red text and red mono labels (open-case tags, inline emphasis). 6:1+ on Night ground and surface, 5.9:1 on Paper ground.

tokens.name: thread-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of thread fills. Text on it is on-thread.

tokens.name: on-thread
tokens.usage: Text and icons on thread or thread-deep fills (4.7:1 on thread, 8:1 on thread-deep). Keep button labels 15px medium or larger.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: manila
tokens.usage: Filing: the EvidenceTag clipped to each object, and case-file folders. Game layer, so tags are rounded (radius-tag). The same in both themes. On Paper ground it's only 1.6:1, so tags carry their own small shadow.

tokens.name: manila-ink
tokens.usage: Text on manila (10:1).

tokens.name: manila-thread
tokens.usage: Red text, stamps and pins on manila (5.6:1). Replaces thread and brass on manila.

tokens.name: manila-line
tokens.usage: Dashed tear lines and rules on manila. Decorative.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Game notes: instructions, hints, unlocks, briefings. A warm off-white, the same in both themes. Always rounded (radius-note) and flat, edged with note-line instead of a shadow. Never #fff: white belongs to evidence.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Text on note (16:1).

tokens.name: note-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and meta on note (6.4:1).

tokens.name: note-accent
tokens.usage: The thread's red when it appears on a note: one emphasised word, the unlock code label (6.2:1). Fixed, because thread-text Night (#FF5A6A) fails on off-white.

tokens.name: note-line
tokens.usage: The edge of a note and dividers inside it. Decorative. Notes are flat: this hairline is their only boundary.

tokens.name: evidence
tokens.usage: Physical evidence: receipts, tickets, printouts, notes found at a scene, photos. Pure white in both themes, always square (radius-evidence) and always lifted with shadow-object.

tokens.name: evidence-ink
tokens.usage: Text on evidence (17:1). A neutral near-black, like printer toner, not the warm brand ink.

tokens.name: evidence-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on evidence: column headers, small print (6.4:1).

tokens.name: evidence-line
tokens.usage: Rules, table lines and tear edges on evidence. Decorative.

tokens.name: evidence-mark
tokens.usage: Ink stamps on evidence (PAID, RECEIVED, VOID) and pen marks (9.3:1 on white). The same red as manila-thread, so red stays one family.

tokens.name: evidence-pen
tokens.usage: Ballpoint ink in handwriting on evidence (11.9:1 on white). Blue-black, so a note reads as written by a person, not printed. Story layer only; the game never writes by hand.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: The phone bezel around a PhoneScreenshot. A physical object, so it follows evidence rules: shadow-object.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Pins on ground, evidence tags, case numbers. A supporting metal, never a second accent or a button. Text-safe on ground and surface in both themes. Not on manila (1.7:1 on Night).

tokens.name: solved
tokens.usage: Correct answer / case closed. Lighter than thread on Night and darker on Paper, so it never relies on hue alone.

families.serif: Newsreader, "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif
families.sans: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Next", "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, system-ui, sans-serif
families.device: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Posters, the landing hero, case titles on the start screen.

styles.name: heading-italic
styles.usage: One phrase of emphasis inside a serif headline. Never a whole line.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Instructions, card titles in the app, button-adjacent headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The guard swears the gate was locked at 11:40. The CCTV says otherwise.
styles.usage: Evidence text, case briefs, everything read on the street.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase file labels: case numbers, tags, timestamps, coordinates.

styles.name: evidence
styles.usage: Times, coordinates, transcripts and anything that should feel like a record.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.usage: Printouts from inside the story: phone records, bank statements, letters. Arimo, so it looks like someone else's office printer, not the game.

styles.name: hand
styles.sample: Meet me at the steps. 11:30. Come alone.
styles.usage: Handwritten notes found at a scene. Never smaller than 22px: it has to be read on a phone at night.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks inside a card.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between a label and its content.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; phone screen side margin.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between cards.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page-level breathing room; poster margins.

tokens.name: radius-evidence
tokens.usage: Everything physical from the story: receipts, tickets, printouts, photos, found notes. Square means 'this is a real object'.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Game: CaseTag, EvidenceTag, inputs. Small game elements.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Game: buttons and segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-note
tokens.usage: Game: GameNote, panels, sheets. Rounded means 'the game is talking to you'.

tokens.name: radius-device
tokens.usage: The phone outline around a PhoneScreenshot (screen 40px). The only rounded evidence, because phones are.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pins and knots only (discs). Never for buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-object
tokens.usage: Physical things on the table: evidence and the phone. Objects cast shadows; the game doesn't. Game notes are flat.

tokens.name: shadow-object-drop
tokens.usage: shadow-object as a CSS filter, for evidence with torn or perforated edges (receipts, tickets, notebook pages), so the shadow follows the tear instead of drawing a rectangle. The Evidence wrapper uses it.

tokens.name: thread-width
tokens.usage: The thread line in UI: dividers, the wordmark, connections between pieces of evidence.

tokens.name: thread-width-hero
tokens.usage: The thread at poster and hero scale.
